string-array.name: whatsnew_notes
string-array.item: New: your devices now find each other through Nostr relays first, with Tawny\'s own service as the backup, so pairing no longer depends on one server
New in Servers: use your own relays, see which ones work, or use only your relays
Security: an expired pairing code, or an old QR code, can no longer be used to connect
